_comment: Single source of truth for every deployment env var / config value. One entry = one value = one destination. Edit here, then run infra/aws/scripts/populate-secrets.sh <env>. See README.md.

secrets.name: SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: JWT signing key. Must be a strong random value in staging/production.

secrets.name: DATABASE_URL
secrets.description: Async Postgres DSN: postgresql+asyncpg://...

secrets.name: TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID
secrets.description: Twilio account SID (primary SMS/OTP).

secrets.name: TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN
secrets.description: Twilio auth token.

secrets.name: TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER
secrets.description: Twilio sender number, E164.

secrets.name: SMS_DISPLAY_NUMBER
secrets.description: Number shown to users in-app (returned by GET /config). Defaults to TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER when blank. Set this explicitly to use a different display identity (e.g., a Messaging Service short code) than the underlying sender.

secrets.name: SUPPORT_EMAIL
secrets.description: Support contact surfaced via GET /config to the mobile app.

secrets.name: MARKETING_ORIGIN
secrets.description: Marketing site origin. Privacy + terms URLs returned by GET /config derive from this server-side; rotating it (e.g., to a different marketing host) updates mobile via /config without a release.

secrets.name: IOS_BUNDLE_ID
secrets.description: iOS bundle ID, embedded in the /.well-known/apple-app-site-association payload so iOS Universal Links claim /r/, /f/, /c/ paths.

secrets.name: IOS_TEAM_ID
secrets.description: Apple Developer Team ID (10-char prefix on the AASA appID, e.g. ABC1234567). Empty disables the AASA file (returns 404), useful in dev where there's no signed app.

secrets.name: ANDROID_PACKAGE_NAME
secrets.description: Android package name, embedded in /.well-known/assetlinks.json.

secrets.name: ANDROID_SHA256_CERT_FINGERPRINTS
secrets.description: Comma-separated SHA-256 fingerprints of the Android signing certs (EAS internal, EAS production, Play App Signing). Each fingerprint is the colon-separated hex format from `keytool -list`. Empty disables the assetlinks file (returns 404).

secrets.name: FIREBASE_CREDENTIALS_PATH
secrets.description: Path to a mounted Firebase credentials file. Reserved for a future FCM push backend; unset today.

secrets.name: STORAGE_BACKEND
secrets.description: Which storage backend to use. Supported: 's3' (AWS S3).

secrets.name: AWS_S3_BUCKET
secrets.description: S3 bucket for photo uploads when STORAGE_BACKEND=s3. Set in ECS task defs by Terraform (aws_s3_bucket.photos.id in infra/aws/primary/ecs_web.tf); for local dev, copy the bucket name from `terraform output photos_bucket`.

secrets.name: AWS_S3_REGION
secrets.description: AWS region for the S3 bucket. Set in ECS task defs by Terraform (var.region in infra/aws/primary/ecs_web.tf); for local dev, use the primary region in infra/aws/README.md (us-west-2 today).

secrets.name: SMS_FAILOVER_PROVIDER
secrets.description: Which SMS failover provider to use. Supported: 'sns' (AWS SNS). Twilio is always primary.

secrets.name: AWS_SNS_REGION
secrets.description: AWS region for SNS SMS failover (when SMS_FAILOVER_PROVIDER=sns).

secrets.name: AWS_SNS_SENDER_ID
secrets.description: Optional sender ID for SNS SMS. Empty = use AWS default (numeric short code).

secrets.name: AWS_SNS_DELIVERY_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Shared secret the Lambda bridge uses to call the backend's SNS delivery webhook (PR 5).

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe API secret key.

secrets.name: STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe publishable key (account-specific).

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe webhook signing secret.

secrets.name: STRIPE_PRICE_ID_MONTHLY
secrets.description: Stripe price ID — Individual Monthly.

secrets.name: STRIPE_PRICE_ID_ANNUAL
secrets.description: Stripe price ID — Individual Annual.

secrets.name: STRIPE_PRICE_ID_DAY_PASS
secrets.description: Stripe price id for the one-time $0.99 24h day pass (mode=payment).

secrets.name: STRIPE_PRICE_ID_GROUP_MONTHLY
secrets.description: Stripe price ID — Group Monthly.

secrets.name: STRIPE_PRICE_ID_GROUP_ANNUAL
secrets.description: Stripe price ID — Group Annual.

secrets.name: BUGSNAG_API_KEY
secrets.description: Backend Bugsnag project notifier API key (distinct from the mobile project).

secrets.name: ENVIRONMENT
secrets.description: Runtime environment name.

secrets.name: DB_SSL_REQUIRE
secrets.description: Require SSL to Postgres. True for RDS Postgres; unset (false) in dev.

secrets.name: GRACE_PERIOD_MINUTES
secrets.description: Minutes after deadline before a check-in is considered overdue.

secrets.name: APP_DOMAIN
secrets.description: Primary app domain. Adjust the staging value if a different staging host is used.

secrets.name: SHORT_DOMAIN
secrets.description: Short-link domain. Separate staging host so a referral/family-plan/sponsor link generated in staging never resolves against the production short-link service (and vice versa). Returned to mobile via GET /config.

secrets.name: MOBILE_BUGSNAG_API_KEY
secrets.description: Mobile Bugsnag project notifier API key (distinct from the backend project). Read by mobile/app.config.js as process.env.MOBILE_BUGSNAG_API_KEY.
